news.title: Charles Schwab is blocking AI agents, too.
news.description:
During an interview with Bloomberg, Charles Schwab Corp. CEO Rick Wurster called out Meta’s AI agent, Muse, saying:
> We don’t want someone just giving their password to Muse, and letting Muse come in and take action on that client’s behalf. We can’t control it, the client can’t control it, something could go wrong and who’s liable? For the protection of the client and for the protection of us, we’re not allowing it.
JPMorgan Chase has also confirmed that it’s keeping AI agents out.

news.title: US SEC proposes wider retail investor access to private assets amid risk concerns
news.description: The SEC has proposed new rules to expand access to private assets typically available only to wealthy investors. These rules aim to allow more professionals to qualify as accredited investors, which may lead to higher returns. Critics express concern that this move could expose retail investors to significant risks and fees. Additionally, proposed changes would allow closed-end funds to redeem shares more frequently and offer varied share classes.

news.title: SingSaver, Singapore's Leading Personal Finance Platform, Launches Home Loans Segment
news.description: Affiliate partnership with Redbrick Mortgage Advisory gives SingSaver users bank-by-bank rate comparison and advice through to applicationThe launch takes SingSaver into Singapore's largest household debt category, worth S$296.4 billion, where the gap between bank home loan rates and the HDB concessionary rate of 2.6% can add up to hundreds of dollars a month for borrowers SINGAPORE, Sept. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SingSaver, Singapore's leading personal finance comparison platform and part of Nasdaq-listed MoneyHero Group (NASDAQ: MNY), today launched a Home Loans comparison category in partnership with Redbrick Mortgage Advisory. The launch takes SingSaver into the largest category of household debt in Singapore and extends its product suite beyond credit cards, personal loans, insurance and brokerage.
